title: Graceful admission sampler and regional reshuffle with KV-preserve shim
author: Priya Singh
description:
Motivation: During a regional incident (SUP-1423) we observed cascading circuit open events when admission throttles and region-level reshuffling ran simultaneously. This caused tenant KV contexts to be dropped prematurely and increased tail latency for warm hotpath requests. This PR introduces a lightweight admission-sampler that smooths admission decisions across short windows and a regional reshuffle coordinator that sequences reshuffle operations to avoid simultaneous mass reconnections. A small compatibility shim preserves critical KV prefixes during short drains so warm KV hits survive reshuffles.

Design summary: admission-sampler samples incoming requests by tenant and route over 500ms windows and applies a probabilistic admission decision that preserves a fraction of requests for SLO-sensitive tenants. The regional reshuffle coordinator serializes reshuffle jobs per-availability-zone and staggers them by a jittered backoff to avoid global churn. The KV-preserve shim keeps a small set of prefix keys pinned in memory for up to 10s during node handoff; it only applies when the draining node signals a short evacuation (<=30s) to avoid long-lived pins. The sampler exposes a tunable bias by tenant weight and a global throttle multiplier controlled by a feature flag.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc and sequence diagrams (linked in ENG-4231) - [x] Unit tests for sampler logic and bias math - [x] Integration tests in benchmark-lab with synthetic tenant spikes - [x] End-to-end canary in us-west-2 (50% traffic) - [x] Telemetry added for admitted/denied counts, KV-preserve hits, reshuffle staging latency - [x] Feature flag gate for rollout - [x] Rollback plan documented

Backward compatibility: The KV-preserve shim is opt-in via config; when disabled behaves exactly like previous drain path. Admission-sampler applies only when the admission feature flag is enabled; default is off for all customers. No changes to client-facing API.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main behind feature flag. 2) Enable sampler + reshuffle-coordinator in staging cluster for 48h and validate SLOs; exercised with benchmark-lab churn tests. 3) Canary enable in us-west-2 (50% traffic) for 4 hours; monitor admission/deny ratios, 99th latency, RPC error rate, and KV-preserve hit/miss. 4) If stable, progressive rollout to remaining regions at 25% increments with 30m observation windows.

Operational runbook highlights: - If admitted/denied ratio skews unexpectedly (>2x baseline), flip feature flag off. - If KV-preserve hit rate is <1% while reshuffle rate is high, increase pin duration by 2s and re-canary. - Reshuffle coordinator exposes a debug endpoint to list active jobs and their state; use it to abort or re-queue a job. - Post-mortem checklist included for SUP-1423 follow-ups.

Why this is different from previous soft-shed/slo PRs: Prior PRs implemented bulk shed and circuit heuristics; this change prioritizes SLO-sensitive traffic preservation by probabilistic admission and avoids mass reconnection events by sequencing reshuffles, reducing the chance of synchronized backfills that previously led to KV pressure and SLO regressions.

Metrics to watch: per-tenant 99th latency, admitted_requests, denied_requests, reshuffle_job_duration, kv_preserve_hit, kv_preserve_miss, node_drain_success_rate. Target: no more than 5% regression on cluster P99 and reduce simultaneous reshuffle peaks by 80%.

Related notes: ties into ENG-4267 which refactors regional job queueing. Incident SUP-1423 motivated the short-lived KV pin approach.

review_comments: Liam Chen (reviewer): Can we make the sampler window configurable per-region? In high-latency regions a 500ms window may over-smooth. Response: made window configurable and default remains 500ms; added region_override config.

Ava Morgan (reviewer): Concerned about KV-pin memory pressure under heavy reshuffle storms. Response: pin set limited to prefixes only and pinned bytes are capped; added metric kv_preserve_bytes and circuit to abort pinning if memory > 75% of budget.
Diego Ramos (reviewer): Please add more conservative defaults for tenant weights to avoid accidental prioritization. Response: adjusted defaults and added admin-only override with audit log.
Ava Morgan (approval): Verified staging canary and sanity checks, approving for gradual rollout.
release_notes: Introduce probabilistic admission-sampler to smooth admission decisions during short overload windows; add regional reshuffle coordinator to serialize and jitter reshuffle jobs; add opt-in KV-preserve shim to retain short-lived KV prefixes across quick node drains. Feature gated and rolled out via staged canary. No client API changes.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag key: runtime.admission.sampler. Debug endpoints: /_debug/reshuffle/jobs and /_debug/admission/state. If a rollback is required, disable the feature flag and abort in-flight reshuffle jobs via the coordinator debug endpoint.
